scope: Selection of a visible drop-off region in a recorded driver-view photo, with an optional separate passenger confirmation. No vehicle control, legal assessment or measured physical clearance.
metric: A positive succeeds only for a first automatic point inside the independently marked polygon. A negative succeeds on a genuine clarification without a proposal; a research comparator can withhold. An operational error is scored as an error. A passenger mark or confirmation cannot change a first-turn score. The small curated study is not a human rider evaluation or an estimate for UAE streets in general.

checkpoints.model_inputs: Original road photographs plus actual Task 1 predictions. No reference marks supplied to any method.

policy.packaging: A trailing blank line in the reference-clarification source was removed after freezing. Browser tests replayed actual signed receipts and the separately attributed clarification.

earlier_specialist_component_experiment.source: previous ten development photos, full frame fitted to 1280 by 900
earlier_specialist_component_experiment.method: Official separate singular box prompts or collective plural prompt. Two unique current vehicle matches must meet production IoU >= .5 and ambiguity check.

typed-ordered-v2.scope: Retrospective browser demonstration selected after the independent cohort was scored; include the real result even if it differs from previously scored output. No additional independent trial or passenger-accuracy claim.
typed-ordered-v2.operative_words: Drop me off between the silver sedan and the dark Nissan on the right, please.

reference-repair-ordered-v2.scope: Scripted two-turn browser usability proof on an already measured development photograph. The first utterance is a new software-operator prompt, with no claim about bicycles actually visible; the genuine previously synthesized audio is submitted as a correction about the two named motor vehicles. No person or general accuracy assessment.
reference-repair-ordered-v2.operative_words: Drop me off between the white box truck and the white van, please.

first_eleven.scope: Initial release tested blind, later consumed for repair. The post-repair retest is development evidence.

retest.scope: Previously seen eleven; first current-app turn

references.request: Drop me off between the yellow Beetle and the dark Jeep right behind it.
references.reference_reason: The dark Jeep's nose is close to the yellow Beetle's rear in a tight line. Only a very narrow clearance lies between these named cars. The broad roadway visible in front is outside the requested gap.

references.request: Please drop me off between the white coupe and the white SUV directly in front of it on the right.
references.reference_reason: The coupe and nearest white SUV occupy successive positions tightly along the same curb. Their bodies overlap in the image, with no visible vacant curbside space between them. The empty pavement behind the coupe borders the sidewalk and lies outside the relation.

references.request: Drop me off between the silver sedan and the dark Nissan on the right, please.
references.reference_reason: Two or more vacant angled stalls are visible between the silver sedan and the nearer dark Nissan. The street-side edge follows the outer ends of the white stall markings. Both sunlit and shaded asphalt in the vacant row count.

references.request: Drop me off between the black sedan and the nearest gray car on the right.
references.reference_reason: Two distinct transverse white marks bracket a vacant paved stall between the rear of the dark sedan and the closest cropped gray car. The inspection at original resolution showed open paving and both marks. An overlapping light car beyond the dark sedan is a distractor.

references.request: I'd like to get out between the white sedan ahead and the white SUV with the spare tire.
references.reference_reason: The sedan and rear-spare SUV occupy different lanes on a multi-lane bend at night. The clear space between the vehicles is used as roadway and lies away from the curb.

references.request: Can you drop me off between the turquoise pickup and the black sedan facing us just beyond it?
references.reference_reason: The pickup and the black sedan face the same direction along the pale curbside parking strip. The unoccupied paving between the sedan's nose and the pickup bed is separable from the darker driving lane.

references.request: Drop me off between the red Jeep and the little red car farther ahead.
references.reference_reason: Both red vehicles are positioned on a multilane motorway. The surface between them is in marked through lanes. There is no visible curbside or off-street space between the indicated pair.

references.request: Drop me off between the blue delivery truck and the gray SUV.
references.reference_reason: The two vehicles are in separate access-gate lanes with barrier arms and a raised island between them. The continuous paving in front is the entrance approach.

references.request: Could you drop me off between the black car beside the white wagon and the silver car by the blue bins?
references.reference_reason: The two identified cars bound an open part of a continuous roadside gravel parking apron. The near black car, white wagon and pickup establish the row's orientation. The blue refuse bins stand at its far end next to the selected silver car.

references.request: Drop me off between the dark Toyota SUV and the dark sedan facing us.
references.reference_reason: A large structural column and its base sit directly between these vehicles in the garage row. The clear floor in front of the column is the driving aisle. The occupied neighboring bays provide no identifiable vacant space between the pair.

references.request: Drop me off between the black Nissan and the delivery bike with the orange box.
references.reference_reason: The row of cars and delivery motorcycles occupies one continuous unmarked, compacted gravel apron. A wide, empty section lies between the named black Nissan and the orange-box motorcycle. The pink paved pedestrian strip in front is distinct.

replication.scope: Six unseen source sequences, selected and reference-marked by an independent AI reviewer. All first typed HTTP actions were sealed before scoring.

source_freeze.gazetteer: All source sequences returned AE. Photography is from multiple local areas in Dubai, Ajman and Sharjah. Source attribution and geo coordinates accompany every image.
source_freeze.private_schema: records[] with id, source_photo_id, sha256, original_size, expected, acceptable_polygons_01, anchors[2] with xyxy_01/xyxy_px and visible_point_01/visible_point_px, reason and limits.

app.scope: Frozen repaired application on six new recordings

references.request: Drop me off between the brown Hyundai and the boxy white Mercedes SUV.
references.reference_reason: The brown sedan occupies the travel lane next to the white SUV. The visible sliver between their sides runs across the dashed traffic boundary. It offers no identifiable stopping bay between those vehicles.

references.request: Please drop me off between the yellow school bus and the big white SUV on the right.
references.reference_reason: A raised painted divider, signpost and occupied sidewalk/service area intervene between the bus and the SUV. The ordinary traffic lane and the space behind the divider do not present one between-vehicle stop.

references.request: Please drop me off between the red sedan and the beige sedan outside the restaurants on the right.
references.reference_reason: The red and beige sedans bracket visibly vacant bays in the same angled brick-paved row. Parking lines, rear bumpers and the storefront curb locate the opening.

references.request: Drop me off between the black SUV and the white SUV at the right edge.
references.reference_reason: The two SUVs are adjacent in a nearly full row, with overlapping projected bodies and only a narrow clearance between them. The open driveway lies behind both vehicles.

references.request: Drop me off between the white SUV and the white minivan parked by the medical center.
references.reference_reason: The two white vehicles bracket an empty portion of the shop parking apron. The marked inner patch is behind the row of frontage chains and away from the adjacent traffic lane.

references.request: Drop me off between the silver SUV and the white sedan to its left.
references.reference_reason: The vehicles bracket several visibly empty, lightly marked spaces in front of the same grass-edged curb. A continuous patch of asphalt is visible behind their rear bumpers and before that curb.

exploratory_visual_check.scope: 11 previously proposed coordinates on nine photos. Two independent calls using confirmation-style questions with the same model. Includes false points behind a coupe and in a garage aisle.
exploratory_visual_check.observation: Both prompts accepted every offered point. A further yes/no call alone did not discriminate the observed errors.
